name: Gaborフィルタ応答
description: 分析します multi-scale, multi-orientation テクスチャパターン using ガボールフィルタs. AI images show more isotropic texture responses lacking directional variation.
algorithm: Multi-orientation Gabor Filter Bank + Anisotropy Analysis
mechanism: It violently pins the canvas down, blasting it with an array of microscopic Gabor wave-slicing scalpels against every texture grid. Distinct from static energy, the 'Response' executioner analyzes the vibrational sensitivity threshold of the pixel array as it rebounds against the Gabor filter. If the algorithm smoothly glides over an authentically soft organic nose-bridge, then violently lurches into an AI-Inpainted synthetic forehead where the frequency response flatlines into a suffocating, dead silence (Reflective distance drastically nullified due to the absence of physical structural pores)... the trial is over. A catastrophic death-sentence is issued pending deepfake confirmation.
useCase: Detecting uniform テクスチャパターン in AI生成の images

references.title: Lyu, S. & Farid, H. (2005). How Realistic is Photorealistic? IEEE TSP.
Manjunath, B.S. & Ma, W.Y. (1996). Texture Features for Browsing and Retrieval. IEEE TPAMI.
Daugman, J.G. (1985). Uncertainty Relation for Resolution in Space and Frequency. JOSA-A.

strengths:
• Multi-orientation テクスチャ分析 captures directional パターン
• Based on well-studied psychophysical model of human vision
• Effective at detecting isotropic AI texture アーティファクト
• Robust にわたる different image content types
• Tunable frequency and orientation parameters
limitations:
• 計算コストが高い with large filter banks
• Parameter selection (sigma, lambda) affects results
• Natural textures with uniform orientation may cause 誤検出
• Resolution-dependent 分析
• Modern AI generators improving at texture diversity
